title: A1
query: What is the functional domain associated with EGFR protein?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR" RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:FUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'  RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100;

title: A2
query: What are the amino acid changes and mutation descriptions for EGFR protein?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName:'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN   CASE     WHEN m:Missense THEN m.hasMutationDescription     WHEN m:OtherMutation THEN m.hasMutationDescription     ELSE NULL   END AS mutationDescription,   CASE     WHEN m:Missense THEN m.hasWildTypeResidue + '/' + m.hasPKAResidue     WHEN m:OtherMutation THEN m.hasMutationAA     ELSE NULL   END AS aminoAcidChange LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' MATCH (p)-[rel:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN m.hasWildTypeResidue, m.hasPKAResidue, m.hasMutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:EGFRfamily)-[:hasMutation]->(m:OtherMutation) RETURN m.hasMutationAA AS aminoAcidChanges, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescriptions LIMIT 100
